$comment: The four things a workstream can ask a human, plus one that is not a question. Every phase terminates in one of these, so the shape matters more than any single instance: a choice is an axis with options, rows are artifacts, and refs are where to look.

items.title: Merge 2 prepared PRs
items.why: land phase: both entries are green on the pair that was approved
items.body: Both entries re-tested after the base moved; patch-ids unchanged, no binary or mode changes.

options.label: Merge both
options.outcome: lander merges each entry whose head still matches its approved sha

options.label: Merge only the rows I select
options.outcome: unselected entries stay open and re-propose next pass

options.label: Do not merge
options.outcome: returns to land with your note attached

items.label: PR 1862 · 14 files +412 −88 · jig 0 error 2 warn · tests green · base moved once
PR 1854 · 31 files +1280 −210 · jig 0 error 0 warn · tests green · base unchanged

items.title: Apply the reconciliation report?
items.why: Linear says 42 Backlog; the branch and its project doc say 26 done or refused
items.body: 26 proposals carry evidence (commit, PR or passing check). 9 are inference-only and will not be applied by `apply --confidence evidence`. 2 are unknown.

options.label: Apply the 26 evidenced proposals
options.outcome: 26 state changes, one receipt each, inference-only proposals left pending

options.label: Apply all 35 proposals
options.outcome: includes the 9 inference-only; each receipt names its confidence

options.label: Apply nothing
options.outcome: the report stays as evidence and the phase stays reconcile

items.label: 26 issues name a commit, PR or check
9 issues matched by branch or title only
2 issues with no evidence either way

items.title: One PR for the remaining 16 leaves, or split?
items.why: sizeBudget: 42 issues and 4,100 changed lines in one open PR
items.body: The preference is one PR per project. At this size the second half will be unreviewable, and a split now is cheaper than a 4,000-line review.

options.label: Continue on PR 1862
options.outcome: recorded as an approved size exception with an expiry, re-proposed at expiry

options.label: Split at the next cohort
options.outcome: finish the current cohort, then open PR 2 for the remainder

options.label: Stop and re-plan the project
options.outcome: phase becomes blocked; no further passes

items.title: Pass 4 raised 3 new warnings
items.why: quality-regressed: jig went from 0 error 0 warn to 0 error 3 warn
items.body: The pass is checkpointed but not accepted. Nothing is pushed to the PR until this is answered.

choices.label: What to do with the pass

options.label: Revert to the last clean checkpoint
options.outcome: the pass stays charged; the workstream returns to land

options.label: Accept the 3 warnings into the baseline
options.outcome: baseline grows by 3 identities; the pass is accepted

options.label: Allow this pass, keep the ratchet
options.outcome: the pass is accepted and the next pass must return to 0 warn

items.title: Reconciled 26 issues against the branch
items.why: no decision needed; the report is the artifact
items.body: 26 evidenced, 9 inference-only, 2 unknown. Report committed beside the workstream record.

rules: kind fyi has no choices and can never be answered — answering it is UnknownOption
every choice has a suggest, because a human reading an item should see what the foreman would do
rows are artifacts, not verdicts: each row carries the numbers a reviewer would check
a blocked item's pass is checkpointed but not accepted; the item says so in body
